bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT 'BLOCKED',e.kind,r.status,q.state,d.status,t.purpose,t.enabled,CASE WHEN d.telegram_message_id IS NULL THEN 'NO_MESSAGE_ID' ELSE 'HAS_MESSAGE_ID' END,CASE WHEN d.rendered_text IS NULL THEN 'NO_TEXT' ELSE 'TEXT_PRESENT' END,CASE WHEN d.inline_buttons IS NULL THEN 'NO_BUTTONS' ELSE 'BUTTONS_PRESENT' END,CASE WHEN d.rendered_text LIKE '%状態：%' THEN 'STATUS_LINE' ELSE 'NO_STATUS_LINE' END,CASE WHEN d.rendered_text LIKE '%<%' THEN 'HAS_RAW_LT' ELSE 'NO_RAW_LT' END,CASE WHEN d.rendered_text LIKE '%&%' THEN 'HAS_RAW_AMP' ELSE 'NO_RAW_AMP' END,length(d.rendered_text) FROM room_status_message_edits q JOIN room_source_events e ON e.event_id=q.room_event_id JOIN posting_deliveries d ON d.delivery_id=q.delivery_id JOIN posting_topics t ON t.topic_id=d.posting_topic_id JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.announcement_id::text=d.source_id JOIN room_posts r ON r.room_id=a.room_id WHERE q.state='needs_reconcile' ORDER BY e.kind" || exit 70
docker logs --since 10m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -E 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY|GAYBBS_WORKER_CHECK_FAILED|GAYBBS_AREA_MENU_SUPPRESSION_FAILED' | sed -E 's/(chat=|id=)[0-9-]+/REDACTED/g' | tail -n 15 || :
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 71
echo TERMINAL_FAILURE_METADATA_READBACK_PASS
